subject: Request: Service commitment carveout for NovaPlatform (Tier 1) — governance + product inputs
messages:
From: Claire Dsouza <claire.dsouza@novaplatform.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Ethan Ross <procurement@novaplatform.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from procurement — NovaPlatform is proceeding toward an enterprise rollout and our security/ops teams are asking for a documented uptime commitment of 99.99% (monthly) for our Tier 1 endpoints. We understand this is outside Redwood's standard public SLA.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a carveout for this account, what the governance path looks like, and an approximate timeline? Procurement will need a short summary to include in the PO. I attached the proposal draft with the expected go-live window.

Thanks,
Claire Dsouza
Director of Infrastructure, NovaPlatform
Attachments: nova_proposal_draft.docx
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform

Laura / Aditya — forwarding a procurement ask from NovaPlatform (deal NP-2026-T1). They want a documented 99.99% monthly uptime commitment for Tier 1 endpoints.

Ask: 1) Product + SRE feasibility: can we offer a carveout with clear fallbacks (model variants, regional routing) and what would be the required mitigations? 2) Commercial: high level on premium pricing/credits if we agree. 3) Governance: who signs off on an exception and what docs do we need?

I cc'd Evelyn for SRE input. I'll pull the proposal into the deal record. Need a go/no-go by EOD Wednesday so procurement can include it in the PO.

-Marcus
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0124
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform

Thanks for the ping. Short answers up front: we can consider a carveout but this will need approval from Product Leadership and Capacity/Governance.

A few product questions to help scope the ask:
- Which endpoints are in scope (inference only, streaming, embeddings)?
- Expected QPS and tail latency targets during peak?
- Are they expecting regional redundancy or single-region guarantee?

Evelyn — can you run a quick impact analysis if they want 99.99% across multi-region vs single-region? If multi-region is required, we should highlight cross-region failover complexity and cost.

Aditya — we may need a premium commit / reserved capacity. Can you prepare a ballpark uplift for a committed pool sized to their expected QPS?

If we can answer those, I can convene an approval thread with Product Leadership (cc: Grant and Priya) and outline the non-standard terms we would require (auto-fallback, maintenance exclusion window, credits formula).

-Laura
Head of Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform

Adding commercial context: for a 99.99% monthly uptime commitment we should expect either a reserved Dedicated pool or a mixed approach (reserved + burst). Ballpark uplift is 45-70% ARR premium depending on commit length and usage smoothing.

I'll draft two options:
A) Reserved Dedicated pool sized to their 95th percentile QPS — higher premium but predictable.
B) Hybrid: reserved baseline + burst on Hosted with stricter routing and penalty clauses.

Also recommend contract language for maintenance exclusions (30–60 min windows with advance notice), and explicit fallback clauses (automatic model variant swap with no SLA credit).

I'll attach a short pricing matrix. Marcus — can you confirm expected QPS so I can size the pools?

- Aditya
Principal Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: sro-pricing-matrix.xlsx
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform

Marcus / team — ran an initial impact analysis (attached). High-level findings:
- Single-region 99.99% is marginally achievable with a dedicated pool sized to their 99th percentile QPS and aggressive prefix/KV caching. Risk: maintenance and unplanned infra events still create exposure.
- Multi-region 99.99% materially increases complexity — requires active-active routing, geo-replication of KV caches, and stricter consistency controls. Rough estimate: ~2.2x cost vs single-region dedicated.

Mitigations we recommend to keep the commitment realistic:
1) Explicit allowed maintenance windows (2x/month, pre-notified) excluded from uptime calc.
2) Auto-fallback to a slightly lower SLA for model-variant swaps; include a notification SLA.
3) Performance SLO monitoring + playbook in the contract; automated failover tested quarterly.

I attached: uptime-impact-analysis.pdf and slo-delta-sheet.csv. If procurement wants contractual credits, we need to define the credit formula (e.g., pro-rated token-month credit) — that will need legal to draft.

Evelyn Hart
SRE Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: uptime-impact-analysis.pdf, slo-delta-sheet.csv
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dsouza <claire.dsouza@novaplatform.com>, Ethan Ross <procurement@novaplatform.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: formal uptime commitment for Tier 1 — NovaPlatform (next steps)

Claire / Ethan — thanks for the patience. Internal review summary below and proposed next steps.

Summary (internal findings):
- Redwood can consider a formal service commitment at 99.99% monthly for Tier 1, scoped to a set of named endpoints and traffic profiles.
- Single-region approach is the lower-cost option; multi-region is possible but ~2.2x cost and requires longer approval.
- We require: (a) a reserved Dedicated pool or hybrid reserved+burst approach, (b) maintenance exclusion windows, (c) an automated fallback clause to a defined lower SLA in certain failure modes, and (d) quarterly failover testing.

Proposed commercial path:
1) Marcus to confirm expected peak QPS and endpoints in scope (please confirm by EOD 9/17).
2) Aditya will provide a formal pricing addendum for the reserved pool vs hybrid option.
3) Legal to draft carveout language and credit formula after commercial selection.
4) Evelyn/SRE will deliver a runbook and quarterly test schedule.

Attachments included in this thread: uptime-impact-analysis.pdf, nova_proposal_draft.docx, sro-pricing-matrix.xlsx, slo-delta-sheet.csv

If you confirm QPS and endpoint list, we'll move to a priced addendum and a targeted signoff within two weeks. Shall I book a 30-min alignment call Thursday?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0124
